mapper.select: select fd_state_code from safety_enter_filing where id=#{id}
select id from safety_enter_filing where fd_state_code in('20','21') and fd_filing_end < now()

select t.id, t.fd_car_no as carNo, t.fd_filing_factory_code as factoryCode, t.fd_filing_factory as factorName,t.fd_dock_no as dockNo,t.fd_dock_name as dockName, t.fd_dock_department as dockDepartment,t.fd_dock_phone as dockPhone, date_format(t.fd_filing_begin,'%Y-%m-%d') as filingBegin, date_format(t.fd_filing_end,'%Y-%m-%d') as filingEnd,t.fd_key as fdKey from safety_enter_filing t where t.fd_state_code='20' and t.fd_key=(select mt.fd_key from safety_enter_filing mt where mt.id=#{id})

select f.id,f.fd_car_no as carNo,f.fd_enter_type as enterType from safety_enter_filing f left join safety_enter_filing_approve a on f.id=a.fd_filing_id where fd_car_no=#{fdCarNo} and f.fd_state_code in ('30','31') and now() between a.fd_filing_begin and a.fd_filing_end
select id as itemCode,field_name as itemName from safety_field_manage t where delete_falg=0 and field_type='factory' and t.remark is null order by field_sort
select field_name as itemName from safety_field_manage t where delete_falg=0 and field_type='factory' and id = #{code}
select * from safety_enter_filing where id=#{id}

select u.user_name from safety_sys_user u left join safety_sys_user_role ur on u.id=ur.user_id left join safety_sys_role r on ur.role_id=r.id where u.user_name=#{userName} and r.role_name='超级管理员' and u.delete_falg='0' and r.delete_falg='0'
select fd_per_card as perCard from safety_enter_filing_per where fd_per_type_code = '10' and filing_id = #{processId}
mapper.delete:
update safety_enter_filing_approve set fd_filing_end = DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) where fd_filing_id in
#{processId}
mapper.select: select case when a.is_show = '1' or b.general_show = '1' then 'false' else 'true' end isShow, b.id as mesId, b.content from safety_small_program_dialog a right join safety_general_config b on a.mes_id = b.id and a.phone_number = #{phoneNo} where b.general_type = 'smallPro'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO safety_small_program_dialog (phone_number, mes_id, is_show) VALUES (#{phoneNo}, #{mesId}, '1')
mapper.select: select t.id, t.fd_state, t.time_out_deal from safety_enter_filing t left join safety_enter_process ps on t.id = ps.form_instance_id where ps.flow_id = #{processId} and t.time_out_deal is null

select t.id, t.fd_state, t.fd_filing_type, fd_enter_type, t.fd_car_no, t.fd_delivery_type, t.fd_filing_factory_code, t.fd_supplier_name, t.fd_supplier_code, t.fd_driver_name, t.create_user, date_format(t.fd_filing_begin,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') fd_filing_begin, date_format(t.fd_filing_end,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') fd_filing_end from safety_enter_filing t left join safety_enter_process ps on t.id = ps.form_instance_id where ps.flow_id = #{processId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM safety.safety_enter_filing t WHERE t.id != #{id} AND t.fd_car_no = #{fdCarNo} AND t.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)

update.foreach: update safety_enter_filing set fd_state = #{l.fdState}, fd_state_code = #{l.fdStateCode}, time_out_deal = '1' where id = #{l.id}

select e.fd_filing_factory_code, p.id, p.filing_id, p.fd_per_type_code, p.fd_per_type, p.fd_per_name, p.fd_per_card, p.fd_per_phone, p.phoneAndCard, r.fd_img as fd_per_img from (select id, filing_id, fd_per_type_code, fd_per_type, fd_per_name, fd_per_card, fd_per_phone, CONCAT(fd_per_phone, fd_per_card) phoneAndCard from safety_enter_filing_per) p left join safety_enter_register r on p.fd_per_card = r.fd_card_no left join safety_enter_filing a on p.filing_id = a.id left join safety_enter_filing_approve e on p.filing_id = e.fd_filing_id where a.fd_state_code = 30 and e.fd_filing_end > now() and p.phoneAndCard in
